import os, json
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-2/play/users/u038/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            touches_edge = False
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                if y == 0 or y == h - 1 or x == 0 or x == w - 1:
                    touches_edge = True
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == background:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        q.append((ny,nx))
            if not touches_edge:
                for y, x in cells:
                    out[y][x] = 4
    return out
'''
